decisions.statement: The folder is watched rather than the file.
The folder above is watched too.
A folder taken away and put back is watched again.
A part whose folder is not there yet is told once that folder arrives.
A write replaces the file itself.
Each part's file sits in a folder of that part's own.
One watcher serves every part reading one folder rather than one watcher for each part.
A part draws the state already there before any change arrives.
A read that failed draws nothing.
The last good read is left on the screen.
A file with the same bytes as the last read is drawn no second time.
Nothing here works a picture out from the repository.
A read that is saved changes nothing a caller can see.
A part is told of no write another part's folder takes.

definition: how a part of the editor reads the one file that part draws
